THIS MISCELLANEOUS FIRST APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, DR.H.B.PRABHAKARA SASTRY J.,MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
None appear for the appellant either physically or through video conference in MFA No.7549/2016.
2. The learned counsel for respondent-Insurance Company in the said MFA, who is for the appellant in MFA No. 5982/2016 alone is appearing, but, through video conference.

3. The said learned counsel for the appellant in MFA No.5982/2016 submits that despite his maximum NC: 2021:KHC:45829-DB effort, the appellant-Insurance Company did not respond, as such, he is unable to make any submission regarding the non-payment of the costs as ordered by this Court and he leaves the matter to the discretion of the Court.

4. By a detailed order dated 08.01.2024, this Court had imposed a cost of `5,000/- upon the appellant in MFA No.5982/2016 while dismissing their IA.Nos.1/2023, 2/2023 and 3/2023 and the cost was directed to be payable by the applicant in those IAs within ten days to the Legal Services Committee of this Court.
On the very same day, another cost of `2,000/- was imposed on the same appellant payable to the Legal Services Committee of this Court for having filed similar set of IAs.

sentences.text: The cost was not paid within ten days time granted to the said appellant.

At the request of the learned counsel for the appellant in MFA No.5982/2016, one more week time was granted under the order dated 18.01.2024.
5.
Admittedly, even in the extended period also, the said cost was not paid.
The matter was listed once NC: 2021:KHC:45829-DB again on 30.01.2024.
Even on the said date also, it was submitted that the cost was not paid.
Still considering the submission of the learned counsel for the said appellant in MFA No.5982/2016, once again time till 06.02.2024 was granted.
On 06.02.2024 also, the result remained the same i.e., the appellant in MFA 5982/2016 has not paid the cost of `5,000/- + `2,000/- = `7,000/-.

On the said date though Court was inclined to pass some strong order, however, considering the request made once again by the very same learned counsel for the appellant, some more time was granted by imposing the additional cost of `1,000/-.
It was also payable to the legal Services Committee of this Court.

Three more days time as prayed for, by learned counsel was granted to report compliance of payment of cost of `5,000/- + `2,000/-
+ `1,000/- = `8,000/- and the matter was directed to be listed to today i.e., on 16.02.2024.
Accordingly, the matter has been listed today.

Learned counsel for the appellant in MFA No. 5982/2016 has made the submission as observed by this Court showing his helplessness since the appellant - Insurance Company is not responding to his instructions and intimation.

7. Under the above circumstances, when the appellant- Insurance Company itself is not interested in paying the cost and proceeding further in the matter despite the maximum effort made by its learned counsel in convincing the Court and getting sufficient time to enable the Insurance Company to deposit the amount, it has to be inferred that the appellant - Insurance Company is not interested in paying the cost and proceed further in the matter.
Accordingly, the appeal in MFA No.5982/2016 stands dismissed for non-payment of the costs and non- prosecution.

The beneficiary of the cost i.e., the Legal Services Committee of this Court is entitled to recover the cost as NC: 2021:KHC:45829-DB ordered above from the appellant - Insurance Company by treating the respective orders mentioned above including today's order as decree of this Court and as an arrears of land revenue, in accordance with law.
To enable the beneficiary to recover the said cost amount, the Registry to transmit the certified copies of the order dated 08.01.2024 up to today's order to the said beneficiary immediately.
Consequently, MFA No.7549/2016 stands de-linked from dismissed MFA No.5982/2016.
